articles.title: Herbicide banned in 70 countries to be pulled from sale in Australia by chemical maker
articles.description:
Syngenta says it will stop selling paraquat in Australia after new regulations on chemical linked to Parkinson’s disease

  • Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast

Syngenta, the producer of a herbicide banned in more than 70 countries and which has been linked to Parkinson’s disease, will stop selling paraquat in Australia, saying new regulations has made it “commercially unviable”.

The decision to pull the product follows new restrictions on the highly poisonous chemical

articles.title: Health worker monitored for Ebola in London hospital after working in DRC
articles.description:
UK resident was evacuated from Democratic Republic of the Congo where there is an outbreak of the disease

A humanitarian worker is being monitored at a specialist hospital in London after potential exposure to the Ebola virus.

The UK resident was medically evacuated from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) where the worker had been treating patients with the disease, the UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA) said.
